about: R. David Donoghue attended law school and graduated from Georgetown University Law Center in 1999. David Donoghue began practicing law in 2001.

David Donoghue is an attorney at Holland & Knight LLP, helping people with Intellectual Property Litigation issues. Holland & Knight LLP has an office in Chicago, Illinois, serving the local community.

David Donoghue was selected to Super Lawyers for 2014 - 2027. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.
